cases.derivation: Resize 2560x1440 BGR source to 1280x720 with cv2.INTER_AREA. Apply terrain.find_line_deployment_edges HSV red ranges [0,70,45]-[28,255,255] or [155,70,45]-[180,255,255], then retain pixels with 5x5 MORPH_TOPHAT redness >=8 inside x=[100,800), y=[100,495). Paint retained pixels BGR=(25,40,180), all others BGR=(50,115,77). Synthetic color rendering of the actual frame red mask; not an independent live screenshot.
cases.observed_outcome: No troop was consumed at the selected upper geometric anchors in the 235131 live battle; the proposed line lay inside the visibly farther-west red perimeter.
